title: Crystalium
description: Crystalium is amodpack focused on Crystal PvP(CPvP) , PvP , and performance, delivering smoother gameplay, higher FPS, and improved stability.
body:
# Crystalium Modpack

> A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on **PvP**, **Crystal PvP (CPvP)**, and **maximum performance**.

Crystalium combines carefully selected client-side and server-side optimization mods to deliver smoother gameplay, reduced lag spikes, faster loading times, and significantly improved FPS while keeping the experience lightweight and competitive.

---

## 🚀 Features

✅ Optimized for PvP & Crystal PvP 

✅ Improved FPS and frame-time stability

✅ Reduced stuttering and lag spikes

✅ Lightweight mod selection

✅ Client-side & server-side optimizations

✅ Fast startup and world loading

✅ Suitable for both **low-end** and **high-end** PCs

---

## 📊 FPS Benchmark

> **Results** may vary depending on hardware, graphics settings, shaders, and Minecraft version.

| Test              |FPS| Optimized for PvP| Stable-Good FPS |
| ----------------- | ------:   | ------: | ------: |
| Crystalium        |     3x Better FPS than Vanilla (Also Depends on Device)   |  ✅Yes |    ✅On Mostly Devices|
| Vanilla Minecraft |    50-70 FPS  |    🚫Not Properly |  🚫Not Good-Stable FPS as Crystalium Modpack |

---


## ⚡ Quick Start

### 1. Install a Launcher

* 💚Modrinth App(Recomended)
*   Any Other Launcher

### 2. Install Crystalium

* Search for **Crystalium**
* Click **Install**

### 3. Launch Minecraft

* Start the game and enjoy smoother performance.

---

## 🎯 Who Is Crystalium For?

* PvP Players
* Crystal PvP Players
* Survival Players
* Multiplayer Server Players
* Users seeking higher and more stable FPS

---

## 📦 Design Philosophy

Crystalium focuses on performance, responsiveness, and stability without adding unnecessary content. Every included mod is chosen to improve gameplay quality, optimize resource usage, or enhance the competitive Minecraft experience.

---

### 💎 Why Crystalium?

**More FPS. Less stutter. Better PvP.**
